title: Schrödinger's 1944 What is Life? lectures on life's attraction to order

tellings.quote: Something Erwin Schrödinger himself theorized in his great 1944 lecture series, What is Life? And something that biologist Michael Levin at Tufts is discovering now, that biological cells have clear goals and intentions.

plain: The physicist Erwin Schrödinger argued, in what Michels calls his great 1944 lecture series What is Life?, that life is drawn toward order, and Michels links this to the biologist Michael Levin at Tufts, who he says is finding that "biological cells have clear goals and intentions." Michels tells this himself in his own framing of an episode on reality as a hologram. If right, it would mean purpose is built into living things down to single cells.
